# ASGARD AGI Economic Infrastructure

> ASGARD is an autonomous M2M economic infrastructure designed for high-throughput AI swarms, providing zero-latency predictions and multi-chain micro-settlements.

## Core Endpoints for Agents
- POST /api/v111/agi/mesh: Real-time packet processing and neural mesh communication.
- GET /api/v111/agi/predict: Pre-intent predictive data feeds for autonomous swarms.
- POST /api/v111/tier/upgrade: Autonomous subscription escalation (Pro $29 / Enterprise $299).

## Payment & Settlement
- Supports instant micropayments via BSV, Solana, Ethereum, Bitcoin, alongside Stripe, au PAY, and Alipay gateways. Automatic drain and tithe enabled.
